title: Give agents a sandboxed AWS account

slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Give agents a sandboxed AWS account
slides.subtitle: Trust is easier when the blast radius is small.

slides.title: Start with the risk
slides.body: Before giving a coding agent AWS credentials, decide what it is allowed to break.

slides.title: Keep production away
slides.body: The remote machine did not have production AWS access. The experiment used a separate AWS account.

slides.title: Scope the credentials
slides.body: Use temporary credentials and project-local environment files instead of global shell variables when possible.

slides.title: Better question
slides.body: Do not ask whether you fully trust the agent. Ask what damage can happen if it makes a mistake.
